title: Decompose monolithic AgentConsoleDrawer into DrawerHeader, DrawerActivityStream, and DrawerSteerBar
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Decomposed the giant AgentConsoleDrawer component (>900 lines) into clean, decoupled React 19 subcomponents: DrawerHeader (window dragging, breadcrumbs, stage stepper), DrawerActivityStream (chronological stream, thinking cards, tool cards), and DrawerSteerBar (steer bar, todo popover, context gauge). Preserved strict adherence to § 2.13 Viewport Overlay & Flex Boundary Invariants.
